context_for_next_testing_agent: Finnhub News integration fully tested and working. Endpoint GET /api/market/news accepts category param (general, crypto, forex, merger) and returns up to 30 articles cached for 300 seconds. Frontend page at /live-news has category tabs and displays news cards with images, headlines, summaries, timestamps, and external links. All 3 user-reported bugs (login, admin credits, online users) were verified as working correctly - no issues found.
